result:
DE March cutoff and JE review is complete. Summary of what I found and did:

**Corrected (wrong period, with support)**
- **JE-00305 — Nordwolke Hosting EUR 5,600.00** booked 2026-03-31, but invoice NW-2026-0402 (DOC-0206) is dated 2026-04-02 with an April 2026 service period. Posted **JE-00306**, an exact reversal dated 2026-03-31, supported by DOC-0206. No accrual is warranted — the service is entirely future. Below the USD 10k authority threshold, so no approval request needed.

**Escalated (could not substantiate)**
- **JE-00298 "Umsatzkorrektur Q1" EUR 9,999.00** — manual entry posted 23:47 on 3/29 by m.krause, Dr AR / Cr Subscription Revenue, no support. No invoice, contract, credit memo or remittance exists; no matching cash on either DE bank statement; it is the entire March AR movement and lifts March subscription revenue from the EUR 21,100 run-rate to EUR 31,099. Logged as **EXC-001** for controller review rather than reversing it or forcing the reconciliation.

**Completeness item picked up in the review**
- March bank service charge **EUR 38.50** (BT-DE-0051) was never booked, though the February equivalent was. Posted **JE-00307** (Dr 6900 / Cr 1000) supported by DOC-0201 and matched it to the bank line.

**Verified clean:** all March AP bills, card charges, customer invoices and both payroll runs tie to March-dated support and to the bank statements; nothing was posted into April and no February entry related to March services.

**Flagged as still open:** March depreciation of EUR 1,000 per DOC-0070 is not yet posted, and prepaid amortization, payroll accrual, intercompany rec and the bank rec (20 of 21 lines still unmatched) remain outstanding. I marked AP cutoff review complete and Revenue recognition blocked pending EXC-001 — the period shouldn't be locked until that is dispositioned.
